description: A professional dermatologist-inspired night routine to address the needs of mature skin, focusing on hydration, repair, and anti-aging benefits.

night_steps.action: Cleansing with a gentle foaming cleanser
night_steps.purpose: Remove impurities and makeup from the skin's surface without stripping its natural oils.
Balance pH levels and prepare the skin for better absorption of subsequent products.

night_steps.action: Serum application using an antioxidant-rich serum
night_steps.purpose: Strengthen the skin barrier, protect against free radicals, and promote collagen production.

night_steps.action: Eye care with a hydrating eye cream
night_steps.purpose: Target fine lines, wrinkles, and dark circles around the delicate eye area.

night_steps.action: Moisturizing with a rich night cream
night_steps.purpose: Lock in moisture overnight to support skin's natural regeneration process and improve elasticity.

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliating with a chemical exfoliant once a week
Face mask application for deep hydration and detoxification

dont: Avoid using harsh scrubs that may irritate the skin.
Do not over-exfoliate as it can lead to dryness and sensitivity.
common_mistakes: Failing to remove makeup thoroughly before cleansing
Not applying enough moisturizer, leading to dehydration

expected_results.2_weeks: Improved skin hydration and reduced appearance of fine lines.
expected_results.1_month: Enhanced skin texture, diminished wrinkles, and increased radiance.
expected_results.3_months: Significantly smoother complexion with a noticeable improvement in overall skin health.

expert_tips: Always patch test new products to ensure compatibility with your skin type.
Stay consistent with the routine for optimal results.
